verdict.rationale: Graphite is a SaaS developer platform, so offering outbound webhooks for users to subscribe to is a fair axis. The only webhook mention is Graphite itself receiving GitHub webhooks for CI status, mergeability, and push events, which is inbound to Graphite and not a user-facing subscription. Slack notifications and 'Automations' on the pricing page are not evidenced as webhook subscriptions, and no API spec was found, so nothing shows users can subscribe to Graphite events.
